title.zh: 修订Tagbilaran市宪章，规定应归该市的公路特别基金与其他用于公共改良的国家资金由公共公路局或公共工程局（视情形而定）管理、规划与支出
title.en: An Act Amending the Charter of the City of Tagbilaran By Providing That the Highway Special Fund and Other National Funds Accruing to the City of Tagbilaran Which Are Intended for Public Improvements Shall Be Administered, Programmed and Disbursed By the Bureau of Public Highways or the Bureau of Public Works, as the Case May Be.
title.orig: An Act Amending the Charter of the City of Tagbilaran By Providing That the Highway Special Fund and Other National Funds Accruing to the City of Tagbilaran Which Are Intended for Public Improvements Shall Be Administered, Programmed and Disbursed By the Bureau of Public Highways or the Bureau of Public Works, as the Case May Be.

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1971/ra_6387_1971.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section ninety-nine of Republic Act Numbered Forty-six hundred and sixty, known as the Charter of the City of Tagbilaran, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 99. Engineering Funds. —The engineering fund of the city shall be considered as city funds as well as all sums of money accruing to the city by virtue of any Public Works Act approved by Congress: Provided, however, That the Highway Special Fund and other national funds accruing to the city which are intended for public improvements approved by the City Board shall be administered, programmed and disbursed by the Bureau of Public Highways or the Bureau of Public Works, as the case may be."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, August 16, 1971.
